name: Clever Chipmunk 18
author: aboalsim114
description: 3d pill teal toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #fff to #f2f2f2, box-shadow becomes 0 0.3em 0.3em #f44444, transform becomes translateX(2.5em) perspective(800px) rotateY(180deg) rotateX(360deg).
